_doc: Notional Labor-v-Liberal two-party figures for South Australian House of Assembly districts whose final count wasn't ALP v LIB. Rows are [alp_votes, lib_votes]. Provenance and verification trail: .build/map/src/sa/notional-adjudication.md. Estimates only — ECSA undertakes alternative counts but publishes only a partial declaration-stage lane for them. Do not add rows by hand without the set assertions in build_sa26_data.py passing.

sa26.credit: The '2-Party Preferred (est)' blocks on Antony Green's district cards and matching 'SUMMARY OF TWO-PARTY RESULTS' '(est)' rows in his SA2026 Draft Analysis (April 2026)

publishedAbsent._doc: Bare by published absence: ECSA undertook alternative Labor-Liberal counts (2026: the seven districts where Labor was excluded during the distribution) but publishes no completed figure for them (its results API carries only a declaration-stage partial machine lane, ~89% of formal), and Antony Green publishes labor-liberal estimates only for the 'divisions' rows above. Croydon's est is a Labor-v-One Nation figure, never a labor-liberal one. These districts stay tpp-less honestly.
